# Master Glossary

Canonical terminology for the BSV architecture. Per-RFC glossaries link back here.

| Term | Definition | Source |
|---|---|---|
| ADR | Architecture Decision Record. | [RFC-0029](../rfcs/RFC-0029/README.md) |
| AEAD | Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data. | [RFC-0003](../rfcs/RFC-0003/README.md) |
| AES-256-GCM | Authenticated symmetric cipher used by BSV. | [RFC-0003](../rfcs/RFC-0003/README.md) |
| Argon2id | Memory-hard password-based key derivation function. | [RFC-0003](../rfcs/RFC-0003/README.md) |
| BSV | Bithat Secure Vault, the offline-first infrastructure asset vault. | [RFC-0001](../rfcs/RFC-0001/README.md) |
| Capability | A narrowly scoped permission granted to a plugin. | [RFC-0020](../rfcs/RFC-0020/README.md) |
| Clipboard Timeout | Interval after which copied secrets are cleared. | [RFC-0014](../rfcs/RFC-0014/README.md) |
| Collection | A logical grouping of objects. | [RFC-0025](../rfcs/RFC-0025/README.md) |
| CRDT | Conflict-free replicated data type. | [RFC-0017](../rfcs/RFC-0017/README.md) |
| Crypto Profile | Named set of algorithms and parameters for a vault. | [RFC-0013](../rfcs/RFC-0013/README.md) |
| DEK | Data Encryption Key; encrypts exactly one object. | [RFC-0007](../rfcs/RFC-0007/README.md) |
| Device Binding | Association of a vault to a specific device via a non-exportable key. | [RFC-0006](../rfcs/RFC-0006/README.md) |
| Generation Number | Monotonic counter used to detect rollback. | [RFC-0010](../rfcs/RFC-0010/README.md) |
| Hash Chain | Linked hashes making tampering detectable. | [RFC-0012](../rfcs/RFC-0012/README.md) |
| KAT | Known-answer test for cryptographic correctness. | [RFC-0026](../rfcs/RFC-0026/README.md) |
| KEK | Key Encryption Key; wraps DEKs. | [RFC-0007](../rfcs/RFC-0007/README.md) |
| Lock Controller | Component enforcing automatic and manual locking. | [RFC-0008](../rfcs/RFC-0008/README.md) |
| Manifest | Signed description of backup contents and metadata. | [RFC-0010](../rfcs/RFC-0010/README.md) |
| Notarization | Apple's malware scan/approval for distributed software. | [RFC-0027](../rfcs/RFC-0027/README.md) |
| Object | The uniform unit of storage in BSV. | [RFC-0025](../rfcs/RFC-0025/README.md) |
| OSAL | Object Storage Abstraction Layer. | [RFC-0019](../rfcs/RFC-0019/README.md) |
| Policy | Declarative rule set governing operations. | [RFC-0015](../rfcs/RFC-0015/README.md) |
| Provider | A concrete storage backend implementation. | [RFC-0019](../rfcs/RFC-0019/README.md) |
| RBAC | Role-based access control. | [RFC-0018](../rfcs/RFC-0018/README.md) |
| Recovery Package | One-time printable material enabling disaster recovery. | [RFC-0011](../rfcs/RFC-0011/README.md) |
| Redaction | Removal of sensitive values before logging. | [RFC-0012](../rfcs/RFC-0012/README.md) |
| RFC | Request for Comments; a versioned architecture proposal. | [RFC-0029](../rfcs/RFC-0029/README.md) |
| Risk Score | Numeric assessment of current session threat level. | [RFC-0023](../rfcs/RFC-0023/README.md) |
| Rolling Migration | Incremental per-object migration. | [RFC-0013](../rfcs/RFC-0013/README.md) |
| Rotation | Replacing a key with a fresh key and re-encrypting protected data. | [RFC-0007](../rfcs/RFC-0007/README.md) |
| Runbook | Step-by-step operational procedure. | [RFC-0028](../rfcs/RFC-0028/README.md) |
| Runtime Monitor | Component observing runtime integrity and threats. | [RFC-0022](../rfcs/RFC-0022/README.md) |
| SBOM | Software Bill of Materials. | [RFC-0027](../rfcs/RFC-0027/README.md) |
| SCIM | System for Cross-domain Identity Management. | [RFC-0018](../rfcs/RFC-0018/README.md) |
| SDK | Software development kit for integrating with BSV. | [RFC-0021](../rfcs/RFC-0021/README.md) |
| Secure Enclave (SE) | Apple hardware coprocessor providing a hardware root of trust. | [RFC-0006](../rfcs/RFC-0006/README.md) |
| Secure Memory Region | Locked, guarded, non-copyable allocation. | [RFC-0009](../rfcs/RFC-0009/README.md) |
| Session | The authorized runtime window between unlock and lock. | [RFC-0008](../rfcs/RFC-0008/README.md) |
| Shamir Secret Sharing | Threshold scheme splitting a secret into shares. | [RFC-0011](../rfcs/RFC-0011/README.md) |
| Trusted Device Set | The set of devices authorized to access a vault. | [RFC-0024](../rfcs/RFC-0024/README.md) |
| Vault | The encrypted repository of objects. | [RFC-0005](../rfcs/RFC-0005/README.md) |
| Version Vector | Structure tracking causal order of object versions. | [RFC-0017](../rfcs/RFC-0017/README.md) |
| View Model | Presentation-layer state holder mediating UI and API. | [RFC-0016](../rfcs/RFC-0016/README.md) |
| Wrapped Vault Root Key | The Vault Root Key encrypted by a Secure-Enclave-protected key. | [RFC-0006](../rfcs/RFC-0006/README.md) |
| Zeroization | Overwriting sensitive memory so it cannot be recovered. | [RFC-0009](../rfcs/RFC-0009/README.md) |
